text:
max: hey team :wave: i’m Max (backend) starting today. quick things — i can’t clone github.com/redwood/runtime (403) and i don’t see myself on the oncall rota or in PagerDuty. also need to sort a temporary badge for office later this week. who should I bug for each?

mina: welcome Max! :tada: for the repo, we usually add new engineers to the `eng-runtime` GitHub team. jamie (infra) owns that. jamie, can you add @max?

jamie (infra): hey @max — i can add you. if you're blocked right now run: `ssh -T git@github.com` and paste the error here. if it's SSO, run `gh auth login --web` and make sure you accept the org SSO prompt. otherwise i'll add you to `eng-runtime` (should be <1h).

max: here's the error when trying to clone: "remote: You don’t have permission to access this repository."

jamie (infra): ok thanks. i've just kicked an invite to your email. accept and then try again. if it still fails, i'll escalate to org-admins.

mina: oncall/PagerDuty — people-ops coordinates the initial rota onboarding, but the SRE rotation is handled by `sre-oncall`. @people-ops can you add him to the onboarding checklist?

people-ops: @max welcome! i'll DM you the new hire checklist and the office badge sign-up link. temporary badge requests go to facilities@redwood.com — cc me and i'll follow up. it usually takes 24–48h depending on building security.

sre-oncall: @max — to get on the PagerDuty rota we need: 1) signed oncall policy ack, 2) pd username, 3) primary contact number. See https://redwood.internal/docs/oncall for steps. If you need emergency coverage before PD access, ping `#eng-oncall` with subject "coverage request" and someone will pick it up.

max: perfect, thanks. one more — if a prod incident hits while i'm waiting for access, who do i escalate to?

jamie (infra): escalate to `sre-oncall` first. if they don’t respond in 10 minutes, page the engineering manager on call (EM oncall is in the same PD schedule). we also have a runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prod-incident (follow the triage header).

devex-bot: Access request logged: request_id=AR-20260301-47 for GitHub team eng-runtime. Estimated completion 45 minutes.

max: awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:

mina: ping me if anything still blocks after the invite — i’ll chase infra/people-ops. enjoy your first day! :coffee:
